msg: Hello, we're a British couple staying at a hotel on Isla Grande in the Rosario Islands for 5 nights. I'm a certified diver (Advanced Open Water, 2 years ago) and my wife doesn't dive. Is there something for both of us?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes! Since you’re both staying on Isla Grande, you can choose activities that fit each of you: you could join a certified-diver trip, and your wife could join a snorkeling tour or ride along as a non-diving companion.

For you, the *5-dive package over 2 days* includes four daytime dives and one night dive. Since you mentioned your last dive was two years ago, the refresher requirement depends on whether it has been *more than* two years.

Both prices are for guests already on the islands.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

Would you like to book the 5-dive package and snorkeling tour, or would the companion option suit her better?

msg: My last dive was just under two years ago, so I should be fine. Actually the 5-dive package seems like a lot, I'd rather do the 2-dive day. My wife would prefer just coming along on the boat without snorkeling. What does that cost for her, and does she get lunch?
reply:
Since you’re already on the islands, lunch isn’t included; the companion plan includes insurance and the National Natural Park entrance fee.

The 2-dive trip for you is available from the islands, and your last dive was less than two years ago, so the refresher requirement doesn’t apply.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Shall we go for the *2-dive trip*, a *multi-day package* or an *advanced course*? 🌊

msg: Sorry, I didn't see the prices. How much is the 2-dive trip for me, and how much for my wife as a companion? Total please.
reply:
Lunch isn’t included for either plan when you’re already on the islands.

I can’t provide a combined total, but those are the individual prices.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Come along as a companion: 80 USD · 89 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD

Shall we go for the *2-dive trip*, a *multi-day package* or an *advanced course*? 🌊

msg: Yes, the 2-dive trip please - but you still haven't told me its price. And the companion at 80 USD is fine. How do we book?
reply:
My apologies for the mix-up!

Lunch isn't included for either plan when you're already on the islands.

The companion plan has no online link, so a team advisor books that one for you. Since you're staying on Isla Grande, pick-up is arranged at your hotel if it has boat access — just tell us the hotel name.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Come along as a companion: 80 USD · 89 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 1 dive (1 day): 97 USD · 108 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Which hotel are you staying at? I need it to book and arrange pickup.

msg: We're at Hotel Playa Blanca Lodge on Isla Grande. Let's do the 2-dive for me (124) and companion for her (80), on Thursday.
reply:
Got it: one 2-dive trip for you and one companion plan for your wife, on Thursday. I can’t confirm or change a booking here, and the Thursday date needs to be confirmed with a team advisor.

Hotel Playa Blanca Lodge isn’t on the list of hotels with confirmed boat access, so the team will need to confirm the pickup point. The 2-dive trip includes full diving equipment and dive insurance; lunch isn’t included. The companion plan includes insurance and the National Natural Park entrance fee, but no lunch.

🤿 *Companion (no diving or snorkeling)*
💰 *80 USD* per person

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*
💰 *124 USD* per person

Your accommodation isn't on our hotel list, so an advisor needs to confirm your pickup before you book and pay.

Would you like me to connect you with an advisor to book and arrange the payment? 🌊

msg: Yes please, connect us with an advisor.
reply:
I'll connect you with an advisor from the Diving Planet team.
They will contact you shortly. Thanks! :)
